title: Newark criminal history in licensing - review, confidentiality and exemptions
requirement: Before taking final action on a license based on criminal history, the City must give the applicant 10 business days to respond and review all submitted information; criminal-history information the City obtains must remain confidential.
coverage_conditions: Decisions on City licenses; exceptions where federal or state law requires or permits consideration of criminal history and for licenses under government programs encouraging licensing of individuals with criminal histories.
exemptions: Where federal or state law requires or permits consideration of criminal history, limited to the offenses and time periods those laws cover; licenses sought under government programs encouraging the licensing, employment or entrepreneurship of individuals with criminal histories.
quoted_span: The applicant shall have 10 business days after receipt of the documents and notices required under 2:31-14 to respond to the City regarding the results of the criminal history inquiry. The City shall provide the applicant with an opportunity to present information and evidence related to the accuracy and/or relevance of the results of the criminal history inquiry
